Case reference: 2021056970.CaseDesc: On November 12, 1998, the remains of an unidentified woman were recovered from North West Connoire in Newfoundland. Case reference: 2014004969.CaseDesc: On July 21, 1966, a friend asked Ronnie Harper to help him remove one of his nets from the waters of Red Sucker Lake in Manitoba. The two men set off in a canoe and when they reached the spot, the men pulled on the line attached to the net, but it wouldn't budge. Increasing their effort, the men pulled harder and the line attached to the weight came loose. The sudden shift caused both men to lose their footing and the canoe to tip over. The men tried to push the canoe closer to shore. After a time, Ronnie told his friend that he was too tired to hold on. His companion pushed on. The survivor then realised that Ronnie was no longer holding on. Efforts to locate Ronnie were unsuccessful and he is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014003922.CaseDesc: On July 15, 1972, Anthony Zukewich and a friend took a canoe out onto Clearwater Lake, located northeast of The Pas in Manitoba. According to witnesses, both men were under the influence of alcohol and had brought alcohol with them into the canoe. They also noted that the lake was extremely rough due to high winds. The pair were seen departing at around 4:00 p.m., heading towards an area known as Long Point. A Long Point resident told the police that he had seen one person in the red canoe, which was sitting flat, indicating weight in the front. The canoe was recovered on July 17th. Despite extensive search efforts, Anthony was never located.

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Case reference: 2023044609.CaseDesc: Mathew Mangeya was last seen at 1:52 a.m. on July 13, 2023, leaving the University of Alberta Hospital Emergency Room with no known direction of travel. Case reference: 2015050297.CaseDesc: On April, 23, 1973, Lucie Gélinas was seen for the last time in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. She was supposed to go to Vancouver, British Columbia with a friend. Investigations were conducted and the location of Lucie and her friend have been unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2021022554.CaseDesc: Muoi Nguyen was last seen on January 5, 1990 and was reported missing on January 12, 1990. Police have not been able to locate Muoi.

Case reference: 2016052751.CaseDesc: On August 4, 2016, Suchand Reddy Pingli was seen for the last time at his apartment in the Le Plateau-Mont-Royal District of Montreal, Quebec. Suchand suffers from health problems and has to take medication regularly. He is from India.
